What is cursor-cli?

Cursor CLI brings Cursor's AI coding agents to the terminal, so they can be run interactively, wired into GitHub Actions, or scripted into other automations without opening the full IDE. It supports the same range of underlying models as Cursor's desktop app, includes a shell mode for running commands with safety checks, and is meant for tasks like auto-updating docs, triggering security reviews, or building custom agents into CI pipelines.

Install cursor-cli on Omarchy

official Omarchy package command
$ omarchy pkg add cursor-cli

Good to know

  • A Cursor account
  • Network access to reach Cursor's model backend
  • A paid Cursor plan for extended agent usage
